subject: maths
question:
Simplify 

9¹⁸ ÷ 3¹⁴ of 27³ × sqrt{6561}
solution:
**Given:**

Expression: 9¹⁸ ÷ 3¹⁴ of 27³ × √6561

**Formula used:**

Convert all numbers to the same base:

9 = 3²

27 = 3³

6561 = 81² = 9⁴ = (3²)⁴ = 3⁸

**Calculation:**

9¹⁸ ÷ 3¹⁴ of 27³ × √6561

Convert to base 3:

(3²)¹⁸ ÷ 3¹⁴ of (3³)³ × 3⁴

⇒ 3³⁶ ÷ 3¹⁴ of 3⁹ × 34

⇒ 3³⁶ ÷ 3⁽14 + 9) × 34

⇒ 3³⁶ ÷ 3(23) × 34

⇒ 3⁽36 - 23) × 34

⇒ 3¹³ × 34

⇒ 3⁽¹³ ⁺ ⁴⁾ = 3¹⁷

**∴ The simplified value is 3¹⁷.**
